{{Top|leg}}
'''Brentaal Space Control''' was an organization responsible for overseeing and regulating space traffic within the [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal system]]. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] transitting near Brentaal Space were required to file a flight plan with Brentaal Space Control. [[Santhe Passenger and Freight]]'s [[SPF 14897]] filed its flight plan with Brental Space Control during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TT">{{WEGCite|story=The Trap (adventure scenario)|book=The Far Orbit Project}}</ref>
